summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The npm package @hubsync/web-sdk-react@6.3.13 declares a `preinstall` script that runs `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (hex `_0xNNNN` identifiers, scrambled string-map dispatcher) and downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/...`, unzips it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and executes the sibling `math_init.js` — a ~727KB Bun-compiled bundle also shipped in the tarball and itself obfuscated with a rotated numeric string array (`WV8StW` shift routine). The bundled payload therefore runs on the installer's machine at `npm install` time under a freshly downloaded alternate interpreter, bypassing Node-based inspection. The tarball ships no native source that would justify pulling an alternate runtime. `package.json` names the package `@hubsync/web-sdk-react` and describes it as "Verdocs Web SDK for React", branding of an unrelated third-party SDK published under a different scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
